'''Blox Hatha''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who served the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] within the [[Trade Defense Force]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Hatha sought to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and became a notable affiliated-[[Rebel privateer|privateer]] instead after being refused formal membership of the Alliance due to previous war crimes.<ref name="TEGtW" />
